Hi! I'm Drake Gonzales, a senior Engineering major at Harvey Mudd College. I am super interested in **RF engineering**: transmission lines, impedance matching, filter design, and the gap between what a simulation predicts and what the network analyzer actually measures. I also enjoy the digital side of electrical and computer engineering, from FPGA and microcontroller systems to CPU design.

This site collects my work across several courses and projects. Head to [Courses](courses.qmd) to see:

- **[E155: Microprocessor Systems](courses.qmd#e155-microprocessor-systems)**: seven FPGA and microcontroller labs and a real-time 3-band audio equalizer
- **[E157: RF Circuit Design](courses.qmd#e157-rf-circuit-design)**: transmission lines, VNA measurements, matching networks, and filter design
- **[Multicycle RISC-V CPU](courses.qmd#multicycle-risc-v-cpu)**: a multicycle processor written in SystemVerilog
- **[Project Posters](courses.qmd#project-posters)**: E80 and the ICRA wildfire poster
